ruleDefinitions.name: Create Volume Shadow Copy with Powershell
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may attempt to access or create a copy of the Active Directory domain database in order to steal credential information Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Win32\\_ShadowCopy.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\)\\\.Create\\(.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ClientAccessible.*"))
